Professional Summary
Android developer with strong mobile engineering focus. Skilled in building and maintaining consumer and enterprise Android applications, improving app stability and performance, and delivering features using modern Android toolkits. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Hyderabad only. Notice period: 15 days.

Technical Skills
Kotlin, Android, Java, Firebase, Coroutines, Room, Git, Linux, Confluence

Work Experience

Android Developer, Infosys (Mar 2026 - Present)
- Implemented offline-first features using Room to cache user data locally, reducing network calls by 42% and improving app launch times; collaborated with QA via Git for CI workflows.
- Developed coroutine-based background sync and retry logic using Kotlin Coroutines to improve data consistency; monitored production issues and triaged on Linux-based build servers.
- Created detailed design and implementation notes in Confluence and worked with product to prioritize fixes, resulting in a 30% drop in crash rate for key flows.

Android Developer, Covalent Infotech (Jun 2023 - Feb 2026)
- Led development of a customer-facing Android app using Kotlin and Java, integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore for real-time updates, increasing DAU by 28%.
- Built modular features with Coroutines for async processing and used Room for local persistence; improved perceived performance by optimizing database queries and reducing UI jank.
- Managed source with Git, wrote release notes in Confluence, and set up Linux-based CI scripts to automate linting and unit test runs before releases.

Mobile Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (Dec 2021 - May 2023)
- Enhanced existing Android application using Kotlin, implemented feature modules and refactored legacy Java components to improve maintainability.
- Integrated Firebase Crashlytics and analytics to surface top crash paths; fixed memory leaks and reduced crash-free users gap by 18%.
- Used Coroutines for network calls and Room for offline caching; documented implementation and runbooks in Confluence.
